question: Onam is a major festival of India primarily celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam **is a major festival of India Primarily celebrated in the **Indian State of Kerala**.
 
• The Onam festival is celebrated because of the Homecoming of **King Mahabali**.
 
• The Onam celebrations include **Pookalam, Kathakli, Onasadhya, Snake boat race, and Pulikali majorly**.
 
• On this Day Religion, caste or creed are not of Importance in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Other Indian States with their Festival__**:

 
 
• Andhra Pradesh: Deccan Festival.
 
• Harayana: Baisakhi.
 
• Gujrat: Navratri.
 
• Goa: Sun Burn Festival.
 
• Jammu and Kashmir: Har Navmi.
 
• Bihar: Chath Puja.
